identificationModule.briefTitle: To Evaluate the Safety and Immunogenicity of 15-valent HPV Recombinant Vaccine in Chinese People Aged 9-45 Years
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomised, Double-blind, Placebo and Positive Controlled, Phase 2 Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Safety and Immunogenicity of 15-valent Human Papillomavirus Recombinant Vaccine (Hansenulapolymorpha) in Healthy Chinese People Aged 9-45 Years

descriptionModule.briefSummary: To evaluate the safety and Immunogenicity of 15-valent HPV vaccine in 9-45year-old participants.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: A Randomized, double-blind, placebo and positive controlled trial is planned in 330 healthy participants across two age groups (18-45 years and 9-17 years) to evaluate the safety and immunogenicity of the 15-valent HPV vaccine.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Percentage of Participants With Adverse Events
primaryOutcomes.description: AE of local and systemic reactions within 30 minutes after each dose
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 30 minutes after any vaccination

primaryOutcomes.measure: Percentage of Participants With Solicited Adverse Events
primaryOutcomes.description: The percentage of participants with one or more solicited AEs was assessed.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 14 days after any vaccination

primaryOutcomes.measure: Percentage of Participants With Unsolicited Adverse Events
primaryOutcomes.description: Percentage of Participants With Unsolicited Adverse Events
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 30 days after any vaccination

primaryOutcomes.measure: Percentage of Participants With Serious Adverse Events
primaryOutcomes.description: The percentage of participants with one or more SAEs was assessed
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From Day 0 after the first dose of vaccination to 6 months after the thrid dose

primaryOutcomes.measure: Percentage of Female Participants With Pregnancy Events
primaryOutcomes.description: The percentage of participants with Pregnancy Events was assessed
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From Day 0 after the first dose of vaccination to 6 months after the thrid dose

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Immunogenicity after receiving 3 doses of 15-HPV vaccine
secondaryOutcomes.description: Geometric mean titer (GMT) of anti-vaccine containing corresponding type of neutralizing antibody in subjects aged 18-45 years on the 31-day after the third dose of immunization
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 31 days after the third vaccination

secondaryOutcomes.description: Seroconversion rate （SCR）of the anti-vaccine containing the corresponding type of neutralizing antibody on day 31 after total immunization in subjects aged 18-45 years
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 31 days after the third vaccination

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Immunogenicity after receiving 3 doses of 15-HPV vaccine among the participants
secondaryOutcomes.description: Geometric Mean Fold Increase (GMI) and 4-fold increase rates of anti-vaccine corresponding types of neutralizing antibodies in baseline seropositive subjects aged 18-45 years at day 31 after immunization
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 31 days after the third vaccination
